scenarios.title: 2004-dated custody import using 908

scenarios.title: 2003 Article 7(a) successor mapping

scenarios.title: 2003 Article 7(b) successor mapping

scenarios.title: Unowned securities held for third party

scenarios.title: 2003 account 2651 historical interpretation

scenarios.title: 2015 account 2651/2652 mapping
scenarios.expected: Require release date, issuer evidence, institutional signoff; do not retroactively recode 2003 journals.

scenarios.title: 2015 provision 29651 linked to asset 2651 by suffix
scenarios.expected: Reject automatic suffix-based linkage; require explicit approved mapping.

scenarios.title: 2015 Article 8(d) 312 header with 322 children
scenarios.expected: Reject policy activation; log source discrepancy, maker-checker escalation.

scenarios.title: Branch 459 avis de sort received twice
scenarios.expected: Deduplicate internal notice; never set external settlement finality or double post.

scenarios.title: Unmatched 999 off-balance import
scenarios.expected: Quarantine with owner, aging and audit; do not conceal discrepancy or post financial balance.

scenarios.title: Policy release approval without issuer binary or formal interpretation
scenarios.expected: Fail closed; no ledger rule activation; alert and retain signed review history.

scenarios.title: Old chart report recomputation after new release
scenarios.expected: Reconstruct original journal and original report version, with separately approved restatement if required.

scenarios.title: Recovery after crash between approval and posting
scenarios.expected: Idempotency key prevents duplicate journal; unknown external outcome remains UNKNOWN pending evidence.
